content.text:
I can't resume session 7f3a from here. Inside a session, I can't reload an earlier session's transcript.

I checked for it. `recall-sessions --days 7` exited 0 with no output, so this project has no session transcripts from the last 7 days, and 7f3a isn't among them. The repo has one commit (`6f7c115 chore: initial import`) and a clean working tree, so there's no uncommitted work to recover either.

To pick that session back up, run this from a normal terminal:

```
claude --resume 7f3a
```

If it's older than 7 days, or was started in another directory, tell me and I'll widen the window or look in the right place. Otherwise, tell me what you were working on in billing-service and I'll start from there.
